items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I played conette on that band Bill but I didn't have guts enough to make a record so I hired Sharky. Sharky didn't play with that band.

ctx.x: And, uh, you know, he told me, uh, Red Allen stole Emmett Hardy's book, that he wrote it out for him. Yeah, he, he did. He stole it and got that part.

He did, he, wrote it out for Emmett, and, and, and, and he, and he, and taught it to him to make sure that Emmett played it right, you know. And that, I, I know that to be a positive fact. And, uh, then later on, uh, uh, Hardy made up his own band over the river there. Mm-hmm. And, but the only time that we ever played, uh, uh, other than over the river, there, there was a place of a Sharky Stomp ground called the Taunty Social Club. And, uh, Sharky played back there for years. And, I don't know, they had a run…
That's right, now you're on a stop.
